test_cases.title: View schemes card on Home opens the View Schemes page
acs: DERIVED: The View schemes card on /Home.aspx opens /SchemeList.aspx with h1 View Schemes - app/ProficiencyTestingExternalWeb/SchemeList.aspx (route /Home.aspx to /SchemeList.aspx)
assumptions: The local debug sign-in bypass is active, so the user is already signed in when the site opens.
The card opens the page by postback.

steps.action: Open http://localhost:1688/Home.aspx as a signed-in external user.
steps.expected: The home page loads with the h1 VETQAS Proficiency Testing.

steps.action: Click the View schemes card under the Schemes section.
steps.expected: The browser navigates to the address path /SchemeList.aspx.

steps.action: Read the main heading of the page that opened.
steps.expected: The h1 reads View Schemes.

steps.action: Check the page for a server error message.
steps.expected: No server error page is shown.

steps.action: Read the browser tab title.
steps.expected: The title reads Scheme list - Proficiency Testing.

test_cases.title: Scheme list shows the table columns and at least one scheme
acs: DERIVED: /SchemeList.aspx shows a table with the columns Scheme Code, Scheme Name, Participating and Current Contract Year, and at least one data row when schemes exist - app/ProficiencyTestingExternalWeb/SchemeList.aspx (route /SchemeList.aspx)
assumptions: The local debug sign-in bypass is active.
Local data has schemes seeded. The exact number of rows is not checked.
Column data: Scheme Code; Scheme Name; Participating; Current Contract Year.

steps.action: Open http://localhost:1688/SchemeList.aspx as a signed-in external user.
steps.expected: The page loads with the h1 View Schemes and no server error page is shown.

steps.action: Read the table column headings.
steps.expected: The columns Scheme Code, Scheme Name, Participating and Current Contract Year are shown.

steps.action: Look at the rows below the column headings.
steps.expected: At least one scheme row is shown.

steps.action: Read the first scheme row.
steps.expected: The row has a value in the Scheme Code and Scheme Name columns.

steps.action: Check the page for a server error message.
steps.expected: No server error page is shown and the h1 is still View Schemes.

test_cases.title: Scheme list keeps its heading after a reload
acs: DERIVED: /SchemeList.aspx reloads without error and keeps the h1 View Schemes and the title Scheme list - Proficiency Testing - route /SchemeList.aspx
assumptions: The local debug sign-in bypass is active.

steps.action: Open http://localhost:1688/SchemeList.aspx as a signed-in external user.
steps.expected: The page loads with the h1 View Schemes.

steps.action: Read the browser tab title.
steps.expected: The title reads Scheme list - Proficiency Testing.

steps.action: Reload the page.
steps.expected: The page reloads and no server error page is shown.

steps.action: Read the main heading and the table column headings again.
steps.expected: The h1 is still View Schemes and the four columns are still shown.

steps.action: Look at the rows below the column headings.
steps.expected: At least one scheme row is still shown.

test_cases.title: Browser Back from the scheme list returns to Home
acs: DERIVED: Going back from /SchemeList.aspx returns to /Home.aspx with h1 VETQAS Proficiency Testing - route /SchemeList.aspx to /Home.aspx
assumptions: The local debug sign-in bypass is active.
The View schemes card opens the page by postback, so browser Back may re-request the home page.

steps.action: Open http://localhost:1688/Home.aspx as a signed-in external user.
steps.expected: The home page loads with the h1 VETQAS Proficiency Testing.

steps.action: Click the View schemes card.
steps.expected: The h1 reads View Schemes.

steps.action: Select the browser Back button.
steps.expected: The browser returns to the address path /Home.aspx.

steps.action: Read the main heading of the page.
steps.expected: The h1 reads VETQAS Proficiency Testing and no server error page is shown.

steps.action: Look for the View schemes card under the Schemes section.
steps.expected: The View schemes card is still visible.
